title: PAR-138 DetailViewStyle group-4 linetype handle insertion fast slice
mode: Generated ASCII/Binary implementation and focused regression validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Insert missing DetailViewStyle group-4 connection/border linetype references (DXF group 340) during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve the repeated handle occurrence mapping when an edited later slot follows omitted earlier slots.
Verify generated ASCII/Binary output with exact ordered raw groups, emitted-target identity, typed readback, reference closure, and neighboring-record continuity.

implementation.behavior: The raw-carrier overlay inserts missing group-4 handle occurrences through the highest edited connection/border line-type slot. If border is edited while the connection slot is omitted and remains at its default, a zero/null connection handle is inserted first. The changed border handle is remapped through normal DXF output planning; the test resolves the emitted VIEW_STYLE_LINE by name rather than assuming the source handle is preserved numerically.
testCases: Remove both group-4 group-340 values from the generated primary DetailViewStyle, confirm typed null defaults, edit border linetype to source handle 0x201, export/reimport in ASCII and Binary DXF, and verify null connection plus border mapping to the emitted VIEW_STYLE_LINE handle.
Compare complete ordered raw DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle carriers, verify closed resource references, and ensure the following POINT is intact.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
The control verifies one later-slot insertion with a null predecessor; it does not cover every linetype combination or malformed cardinality.
No native linetype-rendering or broad DetailViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
The shared worktree is uncommitted and contains unrelated user changes; no cleanup or staging was performed.
